thread:
marta: FYI rolled NCCL 3.2.1 to us-west1 canary pool at 03:10 as part of the driver compatibility push. Seeing intermittent allreduce hangs on 8xA100 inference jobs within the next 5m.
devon: can you paste the minimal logs? are these hangs full deadlocks or long tail latencies?
kevin: most look like full stalls, nv_peer2peer errors then timeouts. attaching snippet from nccl trace: `NCCL WARN Call to allreduce timed out after 120s, rank 3 stuck at step 42`
ryan: also seeing kernel messages on nodes: `kernel: nv_peer_mem: dma_map_sg returned error -12` and repeated slab warnings. might be a kernel-driver interaction with cuobjdump/kernel module refcnts.
infra-bot: deploy-bot: "canary rollout completed to 12 nodes in us-west1 (timestamp 2149587440)" reacted with :eyes:
marta: ugh. can we isolate to specific driver/CUDA combo? which nodes have the new NCCL vs remaining 3.1?
devon: rollout changed NCCL to 3.2.1 but left driver at 535.54 and CUDA at 12.2. Nodes with the new NCCL show the hangs; old canary nodes on NCCL 3.1 are fine.
ryan: this smells like a nccl<>kernel slab/resource leak when P2P is exercised vigorously. I can reproduce with our perf harness (8xA100, sequence length 2048, batching) locally.
kevin: immediate mitigation options: 1) roll NCCL back to 3.1 across wasp-canary nodes, 2) set NCCL_P2P_DISABLE=1 to force P2P off (perf hit), 3) route critical inference routes to single-gpu model variants temporarily.
sre-oncall: customers hitting increased tail lat, some 503s. Support already has ~5 tickets referencing "inference hang" in us-west1. Need a short customer note outlining mitigation.
marta: rollback sounds safest for production. what's the node churn and capacity hit? if we force rollback, we'll need to drain & reprovision ~120 pods; Dedicated tenants on those nodes may need warmups.
kevin: drain + reprovision estimate: ~45m of scheduled work, transient capacity shortfall might push some jobs to other regions if autoscaler fails. costwise small uplift for cross-region spillover — estimate ~$1.2k/day if it runs for 24h.
devon: alternative: set env var on runtime layer to set NCCL_P2P_DISABLE=1 for affected routes only. Benchmarks: ~17% throughput loss for large-seq batched inference but keeps latency stable. That avoids node churn.
ryan: P2P off is acceptable short-term for customer-facing tiers. For internal throughput workloads we should roll back and reproduce in lab with debug builds.
infra-bot: incident-bot: "incident CREATED: nccl-3-2-allreduce-hangs-us-west1 (incident id INC-2026-134)"
marta: plan: 1) immediate — patch runtime to set NCCL_P2P_DISABLE=1 for prod/us-west1 on inference route tags (kevin + devops), 2) support & comms — publish interim note to affected customers (sre-oncall), 3) rollback schedule — after P2P-off buys time, we run full rollback to 3.1 in a staggered window with extra canaries and kernel debug symbols enabled (ryan + devon).
kevin: I'll prep the runtime patch now, canary it to 5% of traffic in us-west1 then ramp. will open PR and tag here.
devon: I'll spin up a debug rack that matches node images and try to reproduce with kernel debug. will collect slab traces and nv_peer logs.
sre-oncall: I'll coordinate customer updates and mark the incident with affected tenant IDs.
marta: if rollback is required later, coordinate capacity with capacity-planning — avoid rolling during peak window 14:00-20:00 PST.
ryan: note for postmortem: collect correlation between sequence length distribution and hang probability; hypothesis: long KV cache sequences exacerbate P2P pathological path in 3.2.1.
kevin: PR: runtime/env patch created — https://git.internal/runtime/PR/4523 will start canary now.
infra-bot: deploy-bot: "config patch deployed to us-west1 canary group (5% traffic)"
kevin: canaries show stable for 10m under P2P-off. throughput down ~16%, tail lat back to baseline.
marta: thanks. keep monitoring for 1h; devon/ryan please continue lab repro. after 1h we decide rollback or full NCCL patch.
ryan: will capture perf traces and maybe produce repro harness to send to NCCL team if needed.
kevin: tracking action items: (1) runtime patch canary/ramp — kevin, (2) debug rack repro + traces — devon/ryan, (3) customer comms + incident updates — sre-oncall, (4) rollback runbook & capacity check — marta.
ms: :thumbsup"
